# Vendored

`xz-decompress.min.js` is `xz-decompress` 0.2.2 (https://www.npmjs.com/package/xz-decompress), unmodified. It is
based on xzwasm by Steve Sanderson (MIT) and contains xz-embedded by Lasse Collin and Igor Pavlov (public domain).
It lets the page decompress the `.img.xz` image in the browser as a stream.
